entries.title: The message box hint stays whole in a narrow window
entries.body: When the message box is too narrow for its grey hint, as in a small window with both side panels open, it now shows a shorter hint, such as "press/hold right ⌥ to talk". Before, the hint was cut off mid-sentence.
entries.noPicture: Recorded before notes kept pictures; a release review takes one if this becomes a highlight.
